foco: Dizer onde eu estava e como as coisas eram no passado com "was" e "were".
conteudoAlvo: I / he / she / it + was / wasn't + ___
Was / Were + ___?, Where were you last night?
yesterday, last week, two days ago, born
comoIntegrar: Troque "am", "is", "are" que já sei pelo passado: "I am at home." vira "I was at home."
Use os lugares e adjetivos que já sei: "They were in Italy last week.", "It was cute."

exemplos.enunciado: Passe para a negativa: "I was at work yesterday."

limites: Só o passado do verbo "to be": sem "-ed" e sem "did", que ainda não estudei.
Posso não dizer o ano em que nasci: a pergunta é só para praticar.
primeiraQuestao: Vamos começar por mim. Complete: "I ___ at home yesterday." Entra "was" ou "were" no espaço?
resumoAutorizado: "I was at home yesterday.", "They were in Italy last week."
Negativa e pergunta: "I wasn't at work.", "Were you at home?", "Yes, I was."
Tempo: "yesterday", "last night", "two days ago"; "When were you born?"
resumoCurto: Passado do "to be": "was", "were", "wasn't", "weren't", "Where were you last night?".
